dreamingSettings.title: Dreams
dreamingSettings.subtitle: Inspect and maintain the background memory promotion sweep.
dreamingSettings.runNowHint: Trigger the managed cron job immediately.
dreamingSettings.configHint: Edits agents.defaults.memory.dreaming and writes back to the gateway config file.
dreamingSettings.configPhaseDeepHint: Full promotion sweep with scoring and time decay (daily at 3 AM).
dreamingSettings.configPhaseRemHint: Cross-entry pattern clustering and dream diary (weekly on Sunday 5 AM).
dreamingSettings.previewHint: Shows the top candidates after rehydration, contamination filtering, and marker/hash dedupe checks. No files are written.
dreamingSettings.runtimeHint: Read-only: effective settings from the gateway, the recall store, and the latest sweep output.
dreamingSettings.statusHint: This reads the store under your configured workspace (memory/.dreams).
dreamingSettings.lastRunHint: memory/.dreams/last-run.json: timing, deep gate config snapshot, ranked/applied counts, and skip reasons. Raw JSON is below for debugging.
dreamingSettings.eventsHint: Audit trail of dreaming phase runs (memory/.dreams/events.jsonl).
dreamingSettings.maintenanceHint: These actions only affect the store/lock files. They do not edit MEMORY.md.
dreamingSettings.confirmResetStore: Reset the dreaming store? This clears short-term recall signals.
dreamingSettings.confirmClearLock: Clear the promotion lock file? Only do this if a sweep got stuck.

systemSettings.title: System
systemSettings.desktopOnlyBody: System integration is available in the xopc Electron app. In the browser, use your OS settings instead.

toggles.openAtLoginDesc: Start xopc when you sign in to this user account.
toggles.keepAwakeDesc: While enabled, the app requests that the system stay awake (agent work may not be interrupted by idle sleep).
toggles.notifyDesktopDesc: Allow the app to show system notifications when you wire them in a future update (preference is saved now).
toggles.notifySoundDesc: Play a sound when a notification is shown (when notification sound is implemented).

systemSettings.permissionsHint: Status is best-effort. After changing system settings, refresh or revisit this page.
systemSettings.permissionsHintDarwin: macOS privacy (TCC) and media status are best-effort. Use Refresh after you change System Settings.
systemSettings.permissionsHintWin: On Windows, microphone and (where reported) screen access follow system-wide toggles. Each link opens a relevant page in the Settings app.
systemSettings.permissionsHintLinux: Linux does not report these states here. We try to open your desktop’s Settings; otherwise a documentation page opens. Grant access in your distro, Flatpak, or portal as needed.

fullDisk.title: Files & storage
fullDisk.desc: Read and write workspace and user data when the OS or sandbox allows (wording and paths vary by system).

screen.title: Screen Recording
screen.desc: Capture the screen for vision features outside the in-app browser.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.desc: Record voice in chat and voice features.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Use global shortcuts and accessibility-related integrations.

automation.title: Automation & app integration
automation.desc: Control or integrate with other apps and services (e.g. Apple Events on macOS, default apps on Windows, or desktop portals on Linux).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: Allow the app in your OS notification settings so alerts can appear.

location.title: Location
location.desc: Location-based tasks when the product uses location.

imageModelsSettings.title: Images
imageModelsSettings.subtitle: Vision (understanding) and image-generation defaults, runtime options, and registered image providers.
imageModelsSettings.crossLinkHint: Primary chat model and sampling are on the Chat tab; text model fallbacks are on the Models tab (same group). This page and Agent defaults together edit vision (understanding) and image-generation fields in agents.defaults.
imageModelsSettings.timeoutHint: Hard cap for one generation attempt; leave empty for the gateway default (120000 ms).
imageModelsSettings.autoFallbackHint: After the primary chain fails, sweep every other configured provider before giving up.
imageModelsSettings.credentialsIntro: Set API keys and optional endpoints here. Values are written to config as providers.<id> (same as environment variables). Keys are never returned in full from the gateway.
imageModelsSettings.regionHint: DashScope: pick a region on its card to set region and the official image endpoint (Custom lets you type both).
imageModelsSettings.endpointPresetsHint: When a card shows endpoint or cluster presets, pick one or use Custom — values are saved as providers.<id>.baseUrl.
imageModelsSettings.imageModelsLinkTitle: Open Images settings for all providers
imageModelsSettings.imageBaseUrlPresetHint: Filled from the region preset; switch to “Custom” to edit.
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyMaskedHelp: Saved keys are hidden. Click the eye to load the key from your config file (providers.<id>.apiKey only — not from environment variables).
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyNotInConfigFile: No API key in the config file for this provider (it may come only from an environment variable).
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyRevealFailed: Could not load key from the gateway.
imageModelsSettings.minimaxClusterHint: MiniMax chooses China vs international by hostname, not a separate region code. The gateway stores that host as providers.minimax.baseUrl (what the runtime reads). DashScope uses providers.dashscope.region plus an image endpoint URL.
imageModelsSettings.falQueueBaseHint: Fal image calls are rooted at a queue URL (default `https://queue.fal.run`). This maps to `providers.fal.baseUrl`.

extensionImageGen.banner: API keys and endpoints are stored globally as providers.<id> (same as Settings → Images). Use either page — they stay in sync.

appearanceSettings.subtitle: Language, appearance, and text size for daily use. Stored in this browser only.
appearanceSettings.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearanceSettings.fontScaleDescription: Adjust text size in chat and reading areas.
